## 1. Group Corporate Structure
NSK Groups operates as a technology holding company. The group governs three independent venture companies and develops proprietary software applications designed for high-scale enterprise and consumer impact.

### The Three Venture Companies:
1. NiTechSpark (nitechspark.site)
   - Scope: Enterprise IT Infrastructure, Linux System Administration, Cloud DevOps, Cybersecurity Hardening, Diagnostic Automation, and SRE.
   - Products engineered by NiTechSpark:
     * NiteOps: Hybrid IT infrastructure monitoring & DPDP 2023 compliance manager.
     * RCA Engine: Automated root cause analysis powered by Claude AI and SSH telemetry gathering.
     * CyberScan: High-performance asynchronous network port scanner with Sonic Recon neural TTS.
     * NiteSentinel / SecureScope: DevSecOps automated system hardening and compliance auditing.
     * Audit Tool: ISO/SOC2 compliance, evidence submission, and CAPA ticketing platform.
     * PropoTrack: Multi-tenant LinkedIn and client proposal lifecycle CRM with win-probability AI.
     * PDF2Excel AI: Industrial OCR extraction engine for complex LME warrants and shipping documents.
     * SecurityCheck Pro: IT security routine weekly checklist automation and n8n workflow monitoring.

2. NiteHire (nitehire.site)
   - Scope: AI-powered talent acquisition, video interviewing, and applicant tracking.
   - Capabilities: Autonomous AI interviewers, asynchronous scoring, dynamic ATS Kanban, digital onboarding.
   - Upcoming Launch (September 1, 2026): Craft Resume — Intelligent AI resume architect and ATS alignment suite.

3. NiteOrbit (niteorbit.space)
   - Scope: Frontier Technology & Emerging Deep Tech Coordinates.
   - Status: Preparation securely deploying.

## 2. NSK Groups Native Proprietary Innovations

### A. Alone AI (NiteBuddy)
- Official URL: https://nitebuddy.nskgroups.website/
- Overview: Emotionally intelligent AI companion with persistent cognitive memory.
- Technical Architecture:
  * Backend: FastAPI (Python) asynchronous microservice architecture.
  * Vector Database: Qdrant vector database managing high-dimensional conversational embeddings for multi-session long-term memory retrieval.
  * Persistence: PostgreSQL (session and user state) + Redis (low-latency caching and rate-limiting).
  * Inference Models: Ollama (qwen3:8b) for local private inference with OpenAI cloud fallback.
  * Frontend: Next.js with Tailwind CSS.

### B. SustainHub
- Official URL: https://sustainhub.nskgroups.website/
- Overview: Corporate ESG and Operational Telemetry Helpdesk Platform.
- Technical Architecture:
  * Ingestion: Secure REST Developer API tokens for real-time machine and server telemetry.
  * Live Data: WebSockets (Socket.io) for real-time dashboard state updates.
  * ESG Tracking: Carbon metrics, recycled waste ratio, circular economy indices, and local economic impact.
  * Public Embed Widget: Sandboxed iframe with customizable theming and postMessage API for anonymous grievance and suggestion submissions.
  * AI Risk Assessment: Algorithmic risk scoring and automated supply chain mitigation suggestions.

### C. NSK Connect
- Overview: Enterprise-grade Android collaboration and secure communications portal.
- Technical Architecture:
  * UI Framework: 100% Jetpack Compose with custom cosmic glassmorphism shaders.
  * Access Control: Multi-Factor Authentication simulation with Security Clearance Quarantine and Admin/CEO approval gates.
  * AI Assistant: Native Google Gemini integration (gemini-3.5-flash) for automated operational text generation.
  * Channels: Dedicated encrypted channels including CEO Office, #sentriya-emergency, and #cyberscan-threats.

### D. SENTRIYA
- Overview: Mission-critical Women & Child Safety ecosystem and emergency response network.
- Technical Architecture:
  * Hardware Integration: React Native / Expo with accelerometer shake detection, 5-press power button listener, and keyword voice triggers.
  * Live Tracking: Real-time WebSockets continuous GPS tracking, route deviation alarms, and geofencing.
  * Forensic Integrity: Background media capture encrypted via hardware keystore and cryptographically hashed for tamper-proof legal custody.
  * Stakeholder Portals: Role-based web dashboards for Police Authorities, NGOs, Parents, and Emergency Responders.

### E. AI Letter Pad (Launching Sept 1, 2026)
- Overview: Enterprise context-aware AI document & executive letter drafting platform.
- Capabilities: Automated generation of legally sound business agreements, formal correspondence, executive memorandums, and corporate announcements.
